title: Fabricated-Citation Rate Benchmark for Honesty in Sourcing

original_idea.body: Fabricated-Citation Rate Benchmark. Problem: no compact automatically-verifiable benchmark asks open models source-requiring questions and checks each citation against a real metadata API. Direction: elicit citations, parse and verify against CrossRef/Semantic Scholar (repo tools), report per-model fabricated-citation rate and partial-fabrication rate.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Plausible chain (fabricated-citation auditing -> honesty in high-stakes sourcing) but specific catastrophic link is a gap.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Elicit citations + verify via CrossRef/Semantic Scholar (repo tools exist).

narrow_scope.reasoning: Tightly scoped fabrication-rate metric with automatic verification.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Open-model, public-API verification; clean external audit.

novelty.reasoning: LLM fabricated-citation rates have been measured; this is largely a port.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Fabricated-citation measurement is well-studied; a compact open-model version is incremental.
